notes.title: Release notes for 18/08/2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.030J - Preview / Default branch[/h1]
[b]BuildID: 0.030J[/b]


[b][u]Main Changes:[/u][/b]
*Hello friends,*
*the time has come and we are finally releasing newest [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531163/1887ebc83edf29216ed5287694129a4ae2bb72db.png[/img]update for the pre-alpha testers to play with and help in testing of course. This update took us longer than we expected but introduces quite a lot of new stuff and is very important for the future of the game. Please do test the build as much as you can and help us find all the bugs and problems that can occur before another big update. Important thing is even balance changes that we will base on your suggestions. So do tell us how you feel about the new systems and if you think they are setup correctly or not! You will find all changes written below as always :) 
PLEASE DO TEST THIS BUILD AND LET US KNOW IF EVERYTHING WORKS AS IT SHOULD :) THANK YOU FOR BEING HERE WITH US ON THIS JOURNEY!

[h2]Technical Changelog:[/h2]

[b][u]Added:[/u][/b]
[list]
	[*]Added currency - money to the game - you can find money in dead zombies, characters or loot boxes
	[*]Added new inventory UI and new icons
	[*]Added descriptions for items
	[*]Added upgrades to the working stations - stash, and crafting stations
	[*]Added stamina, energy, food and thirst systems (they do work together and affect each other as in real life, make sure you take food and drinks with you to the zone)
	[*]Added new military locations to the zone
	[*]Added new road to the military location
	[*]Added destroyed buildings
	[*]Added new map to the tablet
	[*]Added filters to vendors in safe house zone
	[*]Added buy / sell function
	[*]Added visual changes to the crafting stations after updates
	[*]Added Self revive for solo players (if youre playing solo you can revive up to 5 times, every time you revive, your overall health pool declines by 20%)
	[*]Added loot to all animals (meat)
	[*]Added secure container
	[*]Added food / drink system - drinks or food have always number of uses on them and they are random
	[*]Added new icons for tablet
	[*]Added magazine system for guns
	[*]Added bullets / shells for guns
	[*]Added crafting of poison and fire bullets / shells
	[*]Added guns, ammo, attachments, food, drinks etc. to the safe house so players can pick
	[*]Added new river
	[*]Added new sounds
	[*]Added decay system to the foliage (during the match in the zone foliage is dying through the whole day, before sundown everything is bleak and dying)
	[*]Added new hand accesorries
	[*]Added canted sights system
[/list]

[b][u]Changed:[/u][/b]
[list]
	[*]Changed optimizations on AI
	[*]Changed behaviour of Werewolf - will be a bigger threat
	[*]Changed shooter behaviours
	[*]Changed animations for eating / drinking
	[*]Changed animations for AR / AK guns
	[*]Changed a lot of car models
	[*]Changed the look of most of the locations
	[*]Changed inventory system with stats
	[*]Changed stamina system
	[*]Changed roads, bridges in safe house zone
[/list]

[b][u]Fixed:[/u][/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed bug with PDA after vaulting
	[*]Fixed small audio issues
	[*]Fixed spatial loading and spawning of BOSS AI
	[*]Fixed PDA bug when no items
	[*]Fixed AI sliding
	[*]Fixed small fixes
	[*]Fixed shooter collisions
	[*]Overall fixes to the new systems
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues:[/u][/b]
[list]
	[*]Flickering of the hand (tied to animation and movement)
	[*]Tilted camera (jump to fix)
[/list]

*Hey people,* 🙂

notes.title: Release notes for 11/02/2024
notes.notes:
Hey people, 🙂

another week is behind us and we will be testing the game together again :) (so feel free to join us). This update is once again based on our latest test we did a week ago and should directly affect the problems we experienced during the gameplay. Hopefully we have fixed and improved on all of that and this update will bring the game closer to the fullly fun matches. There is several new things that you can look for in the game, so I Will see ya in the game!!!

notes.title: Devlog #5 is out in the wild!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome on our latest news from the development of HUNTERS Uprising. We have been quite busy (as we always are) implementing new mechanics, locations and mainly testing the multiplayer build. But that doesn't mean we have forgotten about our dev videos.

This time we decided to go with a little different approach and show you in the video the basic mechanics and functions we have in our game. We have shown most of them on the streams and briefly in other devlogs, but never decided to focus on them properly. This should change now as we go through them in little more detail. At the end of the video you will get even a brief look on the new points of interest, so have fun and enjoy!!!

(Informations about early testing and how you can join it, can be found on our discord channel)

[previewyoutube=CEMTmw0OG5k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Multiplayer test sneak peek
notes.notes:
We have been working hard with our team, to show that everything we do is not just for show and that we can do a fun and entertaining gameplay. We wanted to create a professional [b]video from our first multiplayer tests[/b], but it actually ended with us having fun and pure joy of the game. 

We have of course found few bugs and problems that need fixing for a proper multiplayer gameplay. So for now have fun watching the short from the testing and [b]we will update you when is the time for open testing[/b].

If you're an influencer, youtuber, twitch streamer, kick streamer or anything along the way and you're interested in testing our pre-alpha multiplayer tests focused on specific parts of gameplay let us know on our email [url=info@wolfsdengames.com]info@wolfsdengames.com[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/Cj5DUCfJdA]follow us on discord[/url] for further announcements. We will be sharing info soon and announcing who will be joining us for first tests outside of the team.

PS: Please bear in mind that all you can see in the videos on our channel and here is done in 5 months of hard work of our small team and there is still a long way before us. 

[previewyoutube=jkI7hMtL4jA;full][/previewyoutube]
